newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica pays 89 ptas total div, details results.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica pays 89 ptas total div, details results.

text.p: Telefonica group in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE: Telefonica said operating results grew strongly as a result of strong income growth accompanied by only a moderate increase in in-house work and by substantial investments in Latin America.

Operating costs grew 20.5 percent, affected by a 55.8 percent rise in supplier and external services costs. This was due to advertising and distribution spending which was aimed at increasing penetration and utilisation of existing services, the firm said.
Total financial expenses fell 7.7 percent year on year, while charges on debt fell 9.3 percent to 182.37 billion pesetas due to more self-financing at the parent and lower interest rates.
Telefonica said tax payments rose to 56.92 billion pesetas, up 44.6 percent from the previous year, due to a rise in the tax rate to 20.6 percent from 17.6 percent.
